rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when something builds up impressively but ends weakly.

example.english: The movie ended anticlimactically after a brilliant buildup.
example.traditional: 套戲前面鋪排得好精彩，最後卻虎頭蛇尾咁收科。

rows.note: Use this when the buildup, promises, or publicity are much bigger than the actual result.

example.english: The new plan turned out anticlimactically, with huge promises but very little actually done.
example.traditional: 嗰個新計劃宣傳到天花亂墜，最後雷聲大雨點小咁，乜都做唔成。

rows.note: Use this when the ending ruins the mood or makes the situation feel disappointingly flat.

example.english: The proposal ended anticlimactically when the fireworks suddenly went out.
example.traditional: 求婚嗰刻本來好浪漫，點知煙花突然熄晒，成件事大煞風景咁完咗。
